reason: My Instagram agents make me pay a deposit and wait weeks with no photos, so a first order with nothing up front and photos before shipping is worth one try. I'd keep it small, a few clothes and a beauty item in one parcel, and see if it actually arrives.
objection: If the thing turns out wrong or fake and I already paid at the door, will they really give me my money back within 3 days, or will I be chasing them on WhatsApp like with the other pages? And no returns if it just doesn't fit me.
would_change_my_mind: If my first order arrives late or doesn't look like the warehouse photo and the refund is a fight, I won't order again.
